entries.message: This update includes align mobile media pages with dashboard rails and improve dashboard freshness and sync reliability.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Make Discover, Watchlist, Ratings, Custom Lists, and History use compact poster-first touch rails on phones
Keep metadata and actions inside consistently sized cards without desktop-width overflow
Fetch more History only at the right edge and preserve the rail position after loading
Restore the dashboard Up Next queue quickly from cached data and refresh it when watch state changes
Keep Up Next data warm across restarts with background revalidation and live update notifications
Resolve Plex episode notifications through the exact parent show while retaining season and episode coordinates for cross-platform matching
Prevent unresolved Plex episode unwatches and rejected episode identities from changing Trakt incorrectly
messageFragments: Fix - Align mobile media pages with dashboard rails
Feature - Improve dashboard freshness and sync reliability
